category_name: Etiquette of praising a fellow Muslim
title: What to say when praising a fellow Muslim - Hisn al-Muslim 231
arabic: إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُم مَادِحاً صَاحِبَهُ لاَ مَحَالَةَ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلاَناً وَاللَّهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلاَ أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَداً، أَحْسِبُهُ – إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ – كَذَا وَكَذَا
transliteration: Aḥsibu fulānan wallāhu ḥasībuh wa lā uzakkī `alallāhi aḥada.
translation: If any of you praises his companion then let him say: I consider (such and such a person), and Allah is his Assessor, (meaning: and I cannot claim anyone to be pious before Allah) if you know of this (good character trait in the person) to be such and such (saying what he thinks is praiseworthy in that person).
explanation: If any of you praises his companion then let him say:
